verificationMode: Offline revalidation of retained production catalog metadata

semanticReview.indexExplanation: The valid, ready unique btree index has exactly (window_id, position, item_path), no included columns, and applies only when kind equals served. PostgreSQL quotes the identifier position when deparsing; this is the same lowercase column used by the migration.
semanticReview.checkExplanation: The validated CHECK permits rendered, eligible, or selected facts, OR served facts only with policy_version watch-exposure-v2 AND NULL visibility_capability. PostgreSQL ANY(array) is equivalent to the source IN list; AND binds more tightly than OR, so the deparsed expression preserves the source parentheses.
semanticReview.validatorCorrection: Accept exactly the expected quoted or unquoted lowercase position key. No other column name, case, expression, order, predicate, key-count or index-validity checks were relaxed.

sourceReceipt.sha256Basis: Original transport receipt bytes before repository formatting; originalProbe preserves its structured content.

originalProbe.transport: Railway SSH / Admin HTTP runtime / pg Client

indexRows.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX watch_surface_exposure_served_item_key ON public.watch_surface_exposure USING btree (window_id, "position", item_path) WHERE ((kind)::text = 'served'::text)

constraintRows.definition: CHECK ((kind::text = ANY (ARRAY['rendered'::character varying, 'eligible'::character varying, 'selected'::character varying]::text[])) OR kind::text = 'served'::text AND policy_version::text = 'watch-exposure-v2'::text AND visibility_capability IS NULL)
